archetype: Organic & Earthy with Premium Editorial Warmth
overview: VoyageAI / Odyssey: An AI-first travel planning & discovery platform that unifies natural language prompt parsing, multi-city day-by-day itineraries, flight & stay search, curated explore feeds (food, nightlife, beaches, activities), and deterministic budget breakdowns. Visual tone is soothing, warm, refined, and vacation-ready with warm sand/cream surfaces, terracotta & deep sapphire accents, crystal glass nav, rich photography, and tight typography.

entry_surfaces./: editorial split hero — left: brand promise, floating prompt box with pre-filled natural language buttons and currency selector (₹ INR default); right: interactive preview trip snapshot card over sun-drenched Phuket longtail boat backdrop
entry_surfaces./trips: clean grid header with active trips count, filter chips (upcoming, draft, past), and high-contrast 'Create New Trip' quick prompt modal trigger
entry_surfaces./trip/:id: unified multi-tab command hub — floating top bar with destination badge, duration, ₹ budget tracker pill, and 6 active view tabs (Itinerary Timeline, Flights, Stays, Explore, Budget Math, AI Copilot)
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth — left side warm terracotta editorial with quotes on wanderlust; right side clean minimalist email/password form with Google/mock SSO option
entry_surfaces./register: branded split auth matching login with instant intent-selector for 'Solo explorer', 'Couple getaway', or 'Group trip'

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.css fonts with @fontsource-variable/playfair-display (heading) and @fontsource-variable/dm-sans (body) + @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono (mono metrics).
2. Use warm-light palette: Page background #FAF7F2, card surface #FFFFFF with subtle borders #E7E2D8. Primary CTA is warm Terracotta (#C85A32), secondary is Deep Teal (#0F4C5C).

3. Seed rich example prompts on the home screen: 'Plan me a 7-day Thailand trip. I want beaches, beach hopping and nightlife. I care less about temples and museums. My budget is ₹1.2 lakh.' and '5 days in Tokyo & Kyoto for street food, anime spots, and quiet tea houses with ₹2.5 lakh budget'.

4. All budget calculations (Flights + Stays + Food + Activities + Nightlife + Transport = Total vs Budget remaining) MUST be deterministic backend Python/frontend JS calculations, with Indian numbering format (e.g. ₹1,20,000 / ₹1.2 Lakh).
5. Accommodation discovery must display explainable match % cards with deterministic reasons (e.g. '96% Match: Fits your ₹8,000/night budget, has infinity pool & 500m from Patong nightlife').
6. Flight cards must clearly show stops, duration, airline logo/mark, timing, baggage info, and external provider booking redirect button with mock/live mode tags.
7. Include conversational AI adjustment sheet/modal ('Ask AI to adjust' -> e.g. 'Add one more day in Krabi', 'Swap day 3 temple with beach club') that updates the timeline seamlessly.

8. Implement data-testid on all key interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='plan-trip-prompt-input', data-testid='generate-trip-button', data-testid='flight-book-link', data-testid='add-to-itinerary-btn').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do NOT use default dark-mode tech gradients or purple neon. Use warm organic stone tones (#FAF7F2) paired with terracotta (#C85A32), deep sea teal (#0F4C5C), and sun-washed accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous breathing room: p-6 to p-10 on cards, py-16 on sections. Never collide text against container borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography: Playfair Display for editorial headings, DM Sans for high-legibility body, IBM Plex Mono for timings/prices/badges.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.images: Use real Unsplash photography provided in image_urls for Thai beaches, pool villas, and night markets. Never use placeholder URLs.
